preconditions.description: The input string length must be between 2 and 500 (inclusive).
The first line must be 'N' followed by a string composed of alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the count of palindromic substrings of length ≥ 2.

postconditions.expression: all(2 <= len(s) <= len(stdin.strip().split()[1]) for s in [stdin.strip().split()[1][i:j] for i in range(len(stdin.strip().split()[1])) for j in range(i+2, len(stdin.strip().split()[1])+1)] if stdin.strip().split()[1][i:j] == stdin.strip().split()[1][i:j][::-1])
postconditions.description: Every counted substring must be a palindrome of length ≥ 2, and the output must equal the total count of such substrings in the input string.
